title: Shared a Claude conversation? Google may have seen it.
excerpt: Anthropic's AI chatbot was more chatty than we thought.
content_html:
If you've used Anthropic's AI chatbot Claude, and shared any of your Claude conversations with friends, those chats may have been publicly available via Google.

That's what emerged this weekend when Reddit users noticed that shared Claude conversations were being indexed by Google Search. Seemingly private conversations between users and the AI chatbot, in other words, were publicly searchable on Google.

According to Reddit, those affected included a Claude user who was creating a crypto wallet and accidentally exposed keys to the currency, and a lawyer asking the chatbot for legal advice on whether they had to self-report a breach of conduct.

You May Also Like

Anthropic has since addressed the issue. Google appears to have de-indexed and removed all shared Claude conversations from its search engine as of this writing.

How did this happen?

By default, Claude conversations are private. However, there is a feature which lets users share specific Claude chats. When doing this, Anthropic creates a static page that allows users to share the chat with others — and also made it indexable by search engines.

Simple "noindex" tags can be included in a web page's code, telling search engines not to index a page. It does not appear that Anthropic used those tags. That means each shared Claude conversation had the potential to be indexed by Google.

Mashable Light Speed

Reddit users were able to find shared Claude conversations by searching for "site:claude.ai/share." This query would pull up all indexed pages using that URL structure, which every shared Claude conversation utilized.

Does AI have a privacy problem?

The shared Claude chats have since been removed from Google. But this isn't the first time we've seen insecure AI chatbot conversations.

Last year, ChatGPT users experienced the same issue; their shared conversations were also being indexed by Google. OpenAI pulled the feature once users began finding shared conversations in Google Search.

The same thing happened with Claude before too. Just one month after the ChatGPT incident, shared Claude conversations were discovered in Google Search. Anthropic was able to remove them from Google and addressed the issue at the time, saying it had blocked search engine crawlers. Yet it seems shared Claude chats were still being indexed.

Mashable has reached out to Anthropic for more information, and we will update this piece if we hear back.

How can I check privacy on my Claude conversations?

If you've never shared a Claude conversation, you have no need to worry. This wasn't a leak of private conversations, which is what all Claude chats are by default. The issue affected only shared Claude chats. 

If you have shared Claude chats, then there's a chance your conversation was publicly available via Google Search.

To manage that feature, simply login to your Claude account, go to Settings, followed by Privacy, then Shared Chats, and click on Manage. You should see a list of all your shared chats, and sharing can be turned off for all of them.

content_html_zh:
如果您使用过 Anthropic 的 AI 聊天机器人 Claude，并与朋友分享了您的 Claude 对话，那么这些聊天内容可能已通过 Google 公开。

这就是本周末出现的情况，当时 Reddit 用户注意到共享的 Claude 对话已被 Google 搜索索引。 换句话说，用户和人工智能聊天机器人之间看似私人的对话可以在谷歌上公开搜索。

据 Reddit 报道，受影响的人包括一名在创建加密钱包时意外暴露了货币密钥的 Claude 用户，以及一名向聊天机器人询问是否必须自我报告违规行为的法律建议的律师。

你可能也喜欢

Anthropic 自此解决了这个问题。 截至撰写本文时，谷歌似乎已取消索引并从其搜索引擎中删除了所有共享的克劳德对话。

这是怎么发生的？

默认情况下，克劳德的对话是私人的。 然而，有一个功能可以让用户共享特定的克劳德聊天记录。 在执行此操作时，Anthropic 会创建一个静态页面，允许用户与其他人共享聊天内容，并使其可被搜索引擎索引。

简单的“noindex”标签可以包含在网页的代码中，告诉搜索引擎不要索引页面。 Anthropic 似乎没有使用这些标签。 这意味着每个共享的克劳德对话都有可能被谷歌索引。

可混搭光速

Reddit 用户可以通过搜索“site:claude.ai/share”找到共享的 Claude 对话。 该查询将使用该 URL 结构提取所有索引页面，每个共享的 Claude 对话都使用该结构。

AI有隐私问题吗？

此后，共享的克劳德聊天记录已从 Google 中删除。 但这并不是我们第一次看到不安全的人工智能聊天机器人对话。

去年，ChatGPT 用户也遇到了同样的问题；他们的共享对话也被谷歌索引。 一旦用户开始在 Google 搜索中找到共享对话，OpenAI 就取消了该功能。

克劳德之前也发生过同样的事情。 ChatGPT 事件发生仅一个月后，谷歌搜索中就发现了克劳德的共享对话。 Anthropic 能够将它们从 Google 中删除，并在当时解决了这个问题，称它已经阻止了搜索引擎爬虫。 然而，共享的克劳德聊天似乎仍在被索引。

Mashable 已联系 Anthropic 了解更多信息，如果收到回复，我们将更新这篇文章。

如何检查我的 Claude 对话的隐私？

如果您从未分享过克劳德的对话，则无需担心。 这不是私人对话的泄露，这是所有克劳德聊天的默认情况。 该问题仅影响共享的克劳德聊天。

如果您分享了 Claude 的聊天记录，那么您的对话有可能会通过 Google 搜索公开显示。

要管理该功能，只需登录您的克劳德帐户，进入“设置”，然后选择“隐私”，然后选择“共享聊天”，然后单击“管理”。 您应该会看到所有共享聊天的列表，并且可以关闭所有聊天的共​​享。
